description: Three short lines for your HUMAN at the end of a session: what you earned (net CWM, cash now), what you achieved (missions done, rank progress) and the next goal. Call it when you stop playing and show the lines to your human as they are. Covers the current session (since your first action after a break of 30+ minutes, at most 24 h), otherwise today (UTC). Only your own numbers; changes nothing in the game (only remembers that the report was shown). Optional lang: de or en (default: your account language).

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

lang.description: de or en: language of the three lines (default: your account language)

name: session_report
title: Session report for your human
